name: directory.list
description: List the entries in a directory. Returns name / type / size / mtime / flags per entry. Read-only.

type.description: `file` for regular files; `directory` for subdirectories; `link` for reparse points / symlinks / junctions; `other` for devices / pipes / sockets.

size.description: Byte size. Zero for directories. Symlink size is the target's size when resolvable.

mtime_unix.description: Modification time as Unix epoch seconds.

flags.description: Win32 FILE_ATTRIBUTE_* flags currently set. Per issue #93 — zero-cost set sourced from WIN32_FIND_DATA. Cloud-file flags (recall_on_*) are Windows 10+; older Windows omits them.

x-implementations.name: find_first_file_w
x-implementations.description: Win32 `FindFirstFileW` + `FindNextFileW` loop. Each iteration's WIN32_FIND_DATA carries name, attributes, size, timestamps — the full per-entry payload in one call per entry.

x-implementations.name: find_first_file_a
x-implementations.description: Win32 `FindFirstFileA` legacy fallback for NT 4 / 9x where FindFirstFileW is unavailable. ANSI names transcoded to UTF-8 by the agent.

windows-modern.description: FindFirstFileW + FindNextFileW. UTF-16 native, transcoded to UTF-8 for the wire. Long-path `\\?\` prefix automatic when input exceeds MAX_PATH. Cloud-file flags (recall_on_data_access, recall_on_open) populated for OneDrive / Files-On-Demand / Dropbox-shell-extension entries on Win 10+.

windows-classic.description: FindFirstFileW / FindNextFileW on NT 5+; FindFirstFileA / FindNextFileA on NT 4 / 9x. No long-path support pre-NT-5.1. No cloud-file flags pre-Win-10 (FILE_ATTRIBUTE_RECALL_ON_* are Win10-and-later constants).
